name: Monkey Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a bundt pan.
Mix granulated sugar and cinnamon in a zip-top bag.
Cut each biscuit into quarters. Toss pieces in cinnamon sugar to coat. Layer in bundt pan.
Melt butter in a saucepan with brown sugar and vanilla. Bring to a boil and cook 1 minute.
Pour brown butter sauce over biscuit pieces.
Bake 30-35 minutes until deep golden brown and cooked through.
Cool in pan 10 minutes then invert onto a serving plate. Pull apart to serve.

substitutions.vegan: Use dairy-free biscuit dough and vegan butter.

notes: Do not skip the 10-minute rest before inverting — the caramel needs to set slightly.
